type MapKeys<T> = { [K in keyof (T & string)]: number };
type RequiredKeys<T> = { [K in keyof (T & string)]-?: number };
type ReadonlyKeys<T> = { readonly [K in keyof (T & string)]: number };
type RemappedKeys<T> = { [K in keyof (T & string) as K]: number };
type OptionalKeys<T> = { [K in keyof (T & string)]?: number };
type Alias<T> = MapKeys<T>;
type OptionalProjection<U extends (OptionalKeys<U> | {length: number})['length']> = U;
type OptionalIntersect<U extends (OptionalKeys<U> & {length: number})['length']> = U;
type Wrapped<U extends Array<(MapKeys<U> | {length: number})['length']>> = U;
type PlainUnion<U extends MapKeys<U> | {length: number}> = U;
type OnlyKeys<U extends keyof (MapKeys<U> | {length: number})> = U;
type LazyMember<U extends {items: (MapKeys<U> | {length: number})['length']}> = U;

type OnlyFalse<V extends false, U extends (V extends true ? MapKeys<U> : {length: number})['length']> = U;
type OptionalReceiver<V extends OptionalKeys<U>, U extends V['length']> = U;
